title: 卡尔玛·翠环高庭
description: 卡尔玛穿完整紫绿长袍站在开阔高庭，额心绿宝石与双龙肩饰清楚，双手自然低放而不施法。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Karma is an adult Ionian woman with warm brown skin, short dark hair, a green forehead jewel, and a distinctive curved twin-dragon ornament behind her shoulders. Preserve her serene focused face and natural adult proportions through a fully covering layered purple-green robe, opaque sleeves, covered legs, and shoes. Any green light remains a restrained ornament, never an attacking beam or spell gesture.
art_direction.scene: Show her standing upright in an expansive empty courtyard, hands lowered loosely in front of her robe and gaze directed over a distant mountain horizon. The twin-dragon ornament frames her shoulders without obscuring the head. Hard sunlight divides jade and purple wax-crayon cloth planes, while a single far arch and broad stone shadows express quiet authority and immense space.
art_direction.palette: jade green, deep plum, warm brown, pale gold light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
